en:
Nyufufufu. Sorry for taking
your New Year's money every
year. This should buy me a new
graduated cylinder.
Hm? It looks like someone else\nhas arrived to receive more\nNew Year's money.
Ah, <player>! Happy New Year~!
This is what they call New\nYear's money, right!? Thank\nyou!
Hawawa... even for me? Is it\ntruly alright for me to accept\nthis?
Eh!? You're giving it to us too?
But, I'm fine. I'm not a child\nanymore, you know.
New Year's money...? And what\nwas with Peppita's strange\ngreeting earlier?
Allow me to explain! These are\nall New Year's traditions that\nremain on Earth.
Otoshidama is a gift where\nadults give money to children.
Heh. I didn't know such a thing\nexisted.

So, this is Lavarnia's first New
Year's on this ship! You know,
there are all sorts of other
customs for New Year's too.

Last time, we did the shrine
visit and feather ball game,
right? I heard people also fly
things called kites.
And then there was the mochi\npounding, too!
Ah, that time... I think we've\nhad enough of Gerel's mochi\npounding.
That's right! Shall we try\nmaking some furisode with the\nReplicator again this year?
Really? Furisode are so\nbeautiful and wonderful, I can't\nwait!
Hmm... The clothes from the\nCaptain's hometown. Maybe I'd\nlike to try wearing one too.
I guess you could say New\nYear's is a pretty lively event.

They are all ceremonies to
celebrate the new year, so
many are said to bring good
luck.

For example, a New Year's
"first dream" is auspicious if
you see beautiful mountains,
hawks, or eggplants!
I wonder why seeing those\nthings is considered good\nluck...?

It's because they'll be happy
dreams! Watching hawks fly
over mountains while eating
delicious eggplants... I want a
dream like that too~.

Were you talking about wanting
good dreams? You were,
weren't you? Then I shall give
you all something wonderful!
Ta-da! It's the Welch-brand\ndrink that guarantees you'll\nhave wonderful dreams!

Just take a big gulp, and you
can dream of whatever you
want, whether it's mountain
ranges or strange birds!
It was made by Welch... I have\na feeling it won't end well.
Hey! This one is the result of\nmany, many failures! So it's\nreally, really, really okay!
I want to try it! I want to dream\nthat I've become a super\nfamous star!
No, wait! We should definitely\nhave Sarah try it!
Ehh? M-me?!

If you have a lucky first dream
of the year, Sarah, it will
become a premonition, and
good fortune will surely visit
the Captain and the others!
I'm more worried about whether\nWelch's drink is actually safe...

Oh man, I guess I have no
choice. But too bad! There's
only enough of this special
drink for one person!

Hmm... In that case, let's be
fair and decide with a game of
Rock-Paper-Scissors between
Peppita and Sarah!
Alright, Sarah, let's battle!
U-Um... O-Okay...
Here we go! Rock, paper,\nscissors!
Peppita & Sarah: Rock, paper,\nscissors, shoot!
Yay, yay, yay! Peppita wins!
Congratulations! This special\ndrink is all yours!
What a tragedy... Sarah, please\ntry to have sweet dreams on\nyour own...!
O-Okay. I'll do my best...
Alright, time to eat! *Gulp...\ngulp...*
A-Are you okay...?
Yeah, it's delicious!
For now, it seems she is fine.
Heh, I told you this one would\nbe okay!
This will let me have sweet\ndreams, right? I can't wait to\ngo to sleep!
Hehe. I hope you have a\nwonderful first dream of the\nyear.
...Ugh... ugh...
Oh, you're awake too, Captain.
Yeah, the sound was bothering\nus too.
It's coming from someone's\nroom... I'm getting worried. Let's\ngo check.
Ugh... uuuugh...!
Peppita has been having these\nnightmares for a while now... I\nwonder if she's okay...?
I knew it, maybe that drink\nWelch gave her was bad...?
Ugh... uuuuugh...! N-no...!
Are you okay, Peppita!? Maybe\nwe should wake her up...
No... I think she might be\nhaving a nightmare. Want to\ncheck?

If we use Succubus powers, we
can enter her dream. If
nothing's wrong, we can just
come back.
You're right... I'm worried, so\nlet's go take a quick look.
We're here. This is the dream\nPeppita is having.
Wait, Tika... What are you\nwearing?
Eh? Oh, what? But you too,\nLavarnia! Why are you in a\nfurisode...?!
What, me too?! How did this\nhappen...?

Ah... we were talking about
furisodos earlier, so maybe my
desire to wear one manifested.
...I'm sorry.
It's okay, Lavarnia, it looks\nreally good on you!
If you're going to say that, then\nyou too, Tika...
Ehehe, thank you!
No, wait! We have to find\nPeppita instead of worrying\nabout furisodos!
Ah, that's Peppita's voice!
Waaaaah! I love signing\nautographs, but not this\nmany...!
Is that... her calligraphy\npractice...?

Yeah. I think it's because we
talked about it today.
Memorable events often
influence our dreams.
She doesn't seem to be having\nfun, so I'm going to go stop\nher.
Wh-what was that?
Something interfered with us...
Something...?
Something is interfering with\nPeppita's dream.
There's something like that out\nthere?!

It's something like a Succubus.
But I think this presence likely
belongs to someone with
malicious intent.
Then, to save Peppita, we'll\nhave to do something about\nthat!
Yeah. However, as for where it\nis...
Early in the year, it's time to\nearn~ Work, work, for the sake\nof the Boss~
...It seems they've told us\nwhere they are.
Mountain Fuji: Hey. There's\nsomething weird over there.
Nasumodoki: Eh? Just leave it\nalone.

Nasumodoki: If we don't collect
this guy's Gem Power quickly,
the Boss is going to be mad at
us again.
An eggplant and... a\nmountain...?

I'm pretty sure they say seeing
those in a first dream is a sign
of good luck, a symbol of
fortune.
I'm sure they're just disguises.\nIf we defeat them, Peppita's\nnightmare should end.
Alright, then we'd better hurry\nand kick them out of Peppita's\ndream!
Zzz... ehehe... I wrote my\nsignature so well... zzz.
Hehe, looks like she's having a\ngood dream. I guess we can\nbreathe a sigh of relief now.
Yeah. Well, shall we get some\nsleep too?
...Ugh... uuuugh...
...Again!?
Whose voice is that!? Let's go\nfind them, Captain.
Ugh, mmm...! Mmm... wait for\nme...!
Now it's Sarah... But Peppita\nwas the only one who drank\nWelch's drink...
We won't figure it out just by\nthinking here. Let's enter the\ndream.
Even Sarah's dream is being\naffected by the New Year's\nfestivities.
It must be that Dream Demon's\ndoing. It should be near Sarah\nagain.
W-wait for me!
Was that... a kite Sarah was\nholding?
Waaaaah! At this rate, it's just\npulling me along; I don't think I\ncan actually fly into the sky!
Um... Sarah. Are you seriously\ntrying to fly using that tiny\nlittle kite!?

Exactly. If you keep going like
that, you'll get tangled in the
kite string and fall before you
even take off.
If we go to help Sarah, the\nincubus might show itself. Let's\ngo, for now.
Yeah. ...It would be bad if this\ndream actually came true.
Sarah! Are you okay?
Ah. Tika!
This thing just keeps moving\non its own... how can I make it\nstop?
Can't you just let go?
Oh! You're right!

Phew... thank you so much. I
was worried I'd get wrapped up
in the kite string and end up
as chicken char siu.
Ahaha... Well, I'm just glad\nyou're safe.
Wow! You both look absolutely\nbeautiful in your furisode!
...Th-thanks.
C-Captain, don't lean in so\nclose! This isn't about the\nfurisode right now...
Sarah, did you see anything\nlike a Nasu-modoki near that\nkite earlier?

No, I didn't see anything. I just
touched something new I'd
never seen before, and then it
just started moving on its
own...
Does that mean it was just a\nnormal nightmare for you,\nSarah?
Nasu-modoki: There's an\nopening!
Gah! That thing from before!
Nasu-modoki: That's my line!\nYou really gave us a scare\nback there.
Why did you all show Peppita\nand Sarah nightmares?
Mountain Fuji: Desires, fulfilled.\nGem power, overflowing!
Mountain Fuji: I'll collect Gems\nuntil I'm empty, then Sis will\npraise me!
Nasumodoki: You idiot! You\ndidn't need to say that!
So you're a Succubus... Still,\ndon't you think you went a little\ntoo far?

Nasumodoki: Look who's
talking, a Succubus! If you
keep getting in our way, I'm
going to get serious!
*Zzz... zzz...* Riding on a giant\nkite... makes you feel like you\ncan really fly...
Yeah, it looks like Sarah's\ndream has returned to normal,\nbut...
That Succubus from earlier\ncalled you "Big Sis." That\nmeans it must still be around.
Then, if we don't defeat it... it'll\nhappen... again...
Wait... I'm so... sleepy...
Tika!
Yeah. It must be that\nSuccubus from before.
Captain, let's go save Tika!
I told you, I'm not doing it!
It's coming from over there,\nhurry!
Nasumodoki: Hurry up and do\nit already!
I know I'm in a dream, so I\nwon't let you have your way\nwith me!
Besides, why do I have to do\nthe Gerel mochi pounding all by\nmyself!
Mountain Fuji: Your wish... shall\nbe granted.
That's not what I want!
You guys should just give up\nalready.
Captain, Lavarnia!
Nasumodoki: Ugh, more extras\nhave arrived.
Lady Hawk: What are you\npunks loitering around for!
Nasumodoki: Ah, Boss! These\nguys keep getting in our way.
Lady Hawk: Are you seriously\nstruggling against a brat like\nthis!?
Nasumodoki: S-sorry!

Lady Hawk: Stop dawdling or
New Year's will be over! Hurry
up, show them a nightmare,
and take their Gem power!
So you're their boss.
Lady Hawk: Hmm...? You're the\none getting in our way? A\nSuccubus, then.
I'm a half-breed.

Lady Hawk: Then you should
get it! We're here to take Gem
power, so don't you dare get in
our way!

If you overdo it, the dreamers
will grow weak. I think that
would be a problem for you
too, wouldn't it?

Lady Hawk: Not my concern!
We were called here for a
reason, so we're going to do
exactly what we came to do!
Nobody called for you!

Mountain Fuji: I wished... to see
a good dream. When wishes
come true, people's Gem power
rises.

Nasumodoki: That's why we let
them do whatever they want,
and in exchange, we take their
Gem power!
I see...
Welch's drink really was a\nfailure, wasn't it...

Lady Hawk: We're busy here!
Now, get back to that fun, fun
mochi pounding until you're
sick of it!
As if I'd do that after hearing\nall that!
I'm sorry, but I have no\nbusiness with you. I'm asking\nyou to leave now.

Lady Hawk: Ha! Look at you
acting tough. I'm gonna turn
you lot into nothing but scraps
of a dream!

Yeah, I think it'll be okay this
time. She should be having
wonderful dreams, just like
Peppita and Sarah. Let's head
back, Captain.
Wait.
Um... if possible, I'd really like\nus to spend the New Year\ntogether.
This child, could it be...?
She really is Tika as a child.
It's hard to imagine this is the\nsame Tika we know now...

Since we defeated the
Nightmare, I think she's inside
the dream Tika was originally
supposed to have.
Um... that's... not allowed, is\nit...?
...I didn't say I'd refuse.
Eh, then...!
Yeah, let's play. You're okay\nwith that too, right, Captain?
Wow... thank you!

Hmm, what should we do?
Playing Hanetsuki sounds fun,
and I'd love to go for a New
Year's visit together, too.

Come to think of it, you used
to spend New Year's with the
Captain and the others, didn't
you?
Yeah! We did so many things\ntogether! Like Hanetsuki... and\nGerel's mochi pounding.
That must have been quite a\nlot of work, right?
It was... but it was fun because\nI was with everyone!

...Hehe, those New Years you
spent with the Captain and the
others really were special to
you.

Yeah. That's why we always
said we'd definitely play
together again... but then I
couldn't see everyone anymore.
...Even though there were so\nmany things I wanted to do.
Eh? We can do all of them?\nAre you sure that's okay...?
I think it's a great idea. I'm\ncurious to see how you spend\nyour New Year's, too.
Wow...! Ehehe.
Then, let's start with\nHanetsuki!
Ah, you're right. You'll have to\nteach us how to play.
Um, so you use this board to\nhit the shuttlecock back and\nforth to compete!
And if you let the shuttlecock\nfall, you get your face drawn\non!
Then I can't afford to lose.
Yep! Okay, first, big brother will\nbe the referee.
...Hah!
Yay! I won, right?!
Tika is the winner. I'm surprised\nby how strong you are.
Ehehe, because Crowe taught\nme the tricks!
Hey, we played plenty of\nHanetsuki, so let's go for\nHatsumode next!
All right. Will you lead the way?
You bet!
You're right. This feels like it's\ngoing to be a wonderful New\nYear's dream for us, too.
Ehehe. Big brother, big sister,\nhurry, hurry!
*Yawn*... Good morning.
Ah, Verda, listen, listen! I had a\nwonderful first dream last\nnight!
Oh? And what was this dream\nabout?
I was signing my name with a\nbrush, and I did it so perfectly!
Heh heh heh! It looks like my\nspecial drink was a huge\nsuccess!
Well, I am a genius, beautiful\ngirl inventor, after all! Sigh, my\nown talent is truly frightening!
Um, I didn't actually drink the\ndrink, but I had a lovely dream\ntoo.
Oh! Was it an auspicious first\ndream!?
Ah, no. It wasn't quite that.
I was riding on a giant kite,\nflying freely through the sky. It\nfelt so wonderful!
Ah, I see... But that sounds like\na lovely dream in its own right!

In that case, I'll update my data
mode with your first dream and
bring good luck to the Captain
no matter what...!
I wonder if that will actually\ncount as a first dream...?
Hehe... It looks like Peppita and\nSarah have both forgotten the\nbad part of the dream.
Yeah. If you don't remember it,\nI think that's for the best.
Ah! But I have to say one thing.
Welch, please don't make that\nspecial drink ever again.
Eh, why? I've already come up\nwith a plan to improve it even\nfurther!
I can't say why, but just don't\nmake it, okay!
Whaaa...? F-fine. If you're going\nto be that insistent...
There, all done.
Did you have a good dream,\nTika?
Actually... I don't remember it\nat all.
Then you must not have seen\nit. Well, I suppose there are\ndays like that.
No, I think I did dream. And it\nwas a good dream, too.
Because when I woke up, I felt\nlike something wonderful had\nhappened!
...I'm sure that means you had\na good dream.
How can you tell?
Succubus intuition.
...Come to think of it, I don't\nremember anything after I left\nSarah's dream yesterday.
Did you... enter my dream by\nany chance?
Captain. It's not something\nworth talking about.
Do you know something too,\nCaptain? I knew it, you peeked\ninto my dream!
Who knows?
Honestly...
...Well, it turned out to be a fun\nNew Year, so I guess I can't\ncomplain.

This story has concluded. We
plan to release various other
stories in the future. Please
look forward to them.
